description: This file defines a repository interface for accessing AuditEntry entities from a database, using Spring Data JPA. It includes a method for retrieving audit entries based on entity type and ID, ordered chronologically.

classes.name: AuditEntryRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for AuditEntry entity providing method to find audit entries by entity type and ID.

methods.name: findByEntityTypeAndEntityIdOrderByCreatedAtAsc
methods.description: Retrieves a list of AuditEntry objects filtered by entity type and entity ID, ordered by creation date ascending.
